comparison: Previous classifications independently execute the frozen owned dev.11 source and match every corresponding immutable dev.11 audit row. Legacy broad membership retains owned dev.8 resolution. No Better Sorting Lua/database executed.

ambiguities.decision: Every current Misc identity is listed below with metadata. Live animals, carriable corpses, financial tokens, props, loose junk and empty waste stay residual; no speculative purpose/name rule. Obtaining and intended use of props/dummy identities requires runtime evidence.

Reviewed rackets, weights, paddles and bowling pin use Recreation; bats, golf clubs, pool cues, hockey/lacrosse sticks and broken instrument necks retain native melee purpose. Generic foreign SportsWeapon stays melee. Alternate player expectations need a human policy decision.

Tarot/Ouja and collectible game objects with memento identity retain Keepsakes where no stronger recreation rule applies. Decide whether occult collectibles should become Recreation before extending that rule.

Initial script fluids determine stable product purpose. Refilling, unknown mixtures and current fluid contents do not recategorize instances. Grenadine, syrup and lemon juice remain ingredients; condensed canned milk follows its reviewed drink family. Further ingredient/beverage distinctions require a human decision.

Verified vanilla writable families use bounded Base identity plus literature/display metadata because CanBeWrite has no exposed instance getter. Foreign writable books without exposed semantic metadata retain literature fallback; no arbitrary name guessing.

Empty fired ceramic vessels/crucibles with native fluid components use Fluid Containers; unfired/cast definitions remain General Materials. Whether foundry/glassworking vessels should instead be specialized tools needs a human decision.

Wooden molds/casts and finished mixed objects remain General Materials; fiber/fabric and fur inputs follow their verified identities. Buttons/beads used as fasteners use Fasteners. Do not classify every wooden finished object as raw wood.

Complete dev.12 General Materials, General Tools, Household Utilities, General Food, Other Containers, General Literature, Other Weapons and Misc member lists are in dev12-final-taxonomy-review.md. Calculator, buckle, drafting compass, paintbrushes, finished glassblowing pipe and ration water are corrected; remaining residual objects retain the reviewed practical storage purposes.

Verified hidden/display-hidden, Base wound/zed-damage representations and four exact development definitions are excluded only from default catalog. Hair/beard/makeup and Book props, TestWaterMug, corpses, animal placeholders and unfamiliar foreign definitions remain available where evidence is insufficient. Native obtainability is untested.

FirearmsOther, MeleeAxes with tool policy on and OutdoorOther remain supported physical fallbacks, hidden until populated or selected. Water, AnimalSupplies, ElectricalComponents/Power and VehicleBatteries are now narrow semantic/legacy identities mapped into consolidated destinations. Recorded Media remains physical: few script prototypes represent many recorded titles. Native mod ownership/load order requires runtime audit. Every dev.12 category under 15 identities is justified in dev12-final-taxonomy-review.md.
